title: Cute, but…
text: Cute, but…. Cute, but not worth $25 for a mass produced item. Also, they arrived chipped, dented and dirty. Not sure if they were used, the store display or just damaged in shipping. I should not have to pay full price for damaged products.

ROMANTIC DESIGN: Our wooden signs are designed with the shape of heart, colored in blue, purple, green, pink and yellow, printed with the words of SWEET HEART, LOVE YOU, KISS ME, XOXO, BE MINE, very romantic and sweet.
DURABLE MATERIAL: Made of good quality wood, our Valentine's Day signs are sturdy and hard to break, they have been precisely cut and painted, can be used and kept for a long time.
SIZE: Each heart-shaped wooden sign measures about 12cm/4.7 inch, and its thickness is about 1.5cm/0.6 inch, which makes them freestanding, very easy to use.

GREAT DECORATION: Suitable for Valentine's Day, wedding, birthday, anniversary and other special days, fitting well with the mantelpiece, coffee table, bookshelf, table, desk and etc., wonderful decoration for your home, office and party, creating romantic and lovely atmosphere.
